row.node: useColumnNames emits an object and duplicate column names contain all values in an array
row.rust: RequestEvent::NamedRow is the Rust payload variant for the row event and preserves duplicate column values in arrays

columnMetadata.node: useColumnNames emits an object keyed by column name and keeps the first metadata entry for duplicate names
columnMetadata.rust: RequestEvent::NamedColumnMetadata is the Rust payload variant for the columnMetadata event
